originalAlarm.description: Value stored to '__driver_data_16' is never read

sanitizedDescription: Value stored to 'driver_data' is never read
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 7acf6cd80b2.c (Linux devpts). 'Value stored to driver_data is never read' at line 39 ('driver_data = &some_int'). On the success path (nondet()=false), 'driver_data = &some_int' is assigned at line 39 and then the function returns 0 at line 41 without using 'driver_data' again. The only read of 'driver_data' is on the error path ('tty_release(driver_data)' at line 44), which is reached via 'goto err_release' at line 36, bypassing line 39. Simplification artifact: in real Linux ptmx_open(), after successfully setting up driver_data, it would be stored in the tty structure for later use. The vbdb simplification stripped that storage step, leaving 'driver_data = &some_int' as a dead store on the success path. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED by CONFIG_UNIX98_PTYS since ptmx_open() is inside '#ifdef CONFIG_UNIX98_PTYS'.
